objects.name: Analytic 1733
objects.description: For iOS, detect Indicator Removal on Host from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Application Permission via Application Vetting [Code-signing entitlements and Info.plist privacy usage-description keys]; OS API Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: App invokes file deletion, container-local database truncation, or cache-clear operations on supervised device within $CleanupWindow$ of prior data access or upload event]; System Settings via Apple MDM [DeviceInformation / SecurityInfo / ProfileList / restrictions and compliance queries]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Privacy cleaner apps approved by IT, MDM agent for managed wipe. Derive from MDM catalog. Tightening: MDM agent only — all other post-exfil cleanup is anomalous.
Default 300s after exfiltration event (network upload) within which subsequent cleanup is causally linked. Tightening: 60s — immediate post-exfil cleanup.
